name: Soft Landing
invitation: A gold circle sits down the clearing. A block and a bank start off to the side. The shot can change, and so can those two pieces.
physicalQuestion: Can a landing be made easier to repeat?
nearbySensitivity: The aim sliders step yaw by 0.5°. At elevation 18° and charge 0.55, yaw 0.5° and yaw -0.5° both still miss. First ground stays about 17.86 m from the circle centre. This is the neighbourhood of the opening miss, not a clear.
validationEvidence: The tested shot is the opening arrangement and the opening aim. Headless Havok through scripts/range/run.mjs reproduces that first-ground terminal. The shot misses. It is the arrangement a player enters. The nearby note was fired the same way and is not replayed by the validator. Measured clears stay in the range appendix and are not stored here.

limitations.concept: A first-ground landing that can be made easier to repeat with the block and the bank
limitations.missing: Pieces have no height, scale, or ramp-pitch control, so a stepped descent or a second floor cannot be built.
limitations.extension: One height offset on the existing block, keeping its friction and restitution. No new contact law and no general mesh.
